prompt: Princess Zelda from The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, a young elf woman with pointed ears, green eyes, and very long straight golden-blonde hair parted in the center, with thin braids along each side of the head that join at the back, and two blue hairclips. She wears a high white mandarin-collared undershirt with a textured geometric pattern, under a short blue cropped tunic with gold trim and a gold and blue patterned band across the midsection. The sleeves are blue at the shoulders and flare into loose, puffy cream-white sleeves with blue and gold cuffs. A wide brown leather belt with carved patterns sits at the waist over the hem of a blue tunic skirt with gold trim. A Sheikah Slate tablet with a red and gold emblem hangs from the belt. She wears black fingerless gloves, dark brown fitted trousers, and brown leather knee-high boots with tan folded cuffs at the top and buckled straps.

fan_art.character: Princess Zelda from The Legend of Zelda
